integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 3D CG, cinematic, semi-realistic. A ruined school corridor at dusk, a giant serpent reared two big steps to the boy's right, with clear open ground between it and him. Silver light gathers in the girl's raised palm, her brows slam down and her jaw locks, loose gravel lifts off the floor around her feet and the corridor lights die one by one toward the serpent. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at fast speed. [Shot 2] At 00:01.000, within a single frame a blinding silver-white column of light thicker than a man is already rammed into the serpent's mid-body, with no visible travel. At that most violent instant the picture flashes through a burst of four impact frames of the same composition, each held about 0.2 seconds with no normal frame in between, each harsher than the last: first pure white; then stark black and white, the serpent as a black silhouette on white with thick black radial streaks bursting out from the point of impact; then a red-orange frame with a huge white shockwave ring tearing outward; finally black with every edge drawn as glowing silver-white lines. Every impact frame shows the attack itself. [Shot 3] At 00:02.000, the burst cuts straight back to the same camera with the column still blasting: in the very first returning frame a white shockwave ring is already tearing outward, the camera jolts violently three times, each smaller than the last, settling within half a second. The serpent's scales peel back in long strips, blackened and smoking, the floor is ploughed open into a glowing trench and the whole row of windows bursts into glittering shards. In the same unbroken moment the wave tears the boy off his knees and flings him out of frame. A second shockwave ring blasts outward. [Shot 4] At 00:03.700, the camera cuts to a medium shot of the boy already slumped against the far wall in a shallow crater of broken plaster, his eyes flying wide and his chest heaving as dust pours down around him.
overall_soundscape: A charging shriek rises; during the impact frames a rapid string of electric shrieks climbs higher and higher; on the return a single deafening boom with a sustained low rumble, glass and concrete crashing down, then the boy's ragged breathing.
